notes.title: Amazething 1.0
notes.content:
Here we gooooo! With finishing the last levels and squashing the remaining bugs I had on my list I'll call for 1.0. 
I will continue to fix bugs that come up, but will probably pause with adding additional for now as I want to focus on new projects.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 29
[*] Level 30
[*] Level 18 has been replaces
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed masking in the main menu
[*] Fixed scrolling in the level selection. 
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Game now pauses when your controller disconnects
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed masking in the main menu
Fixed scrolling in the level selection.

notes.title: Amazething v0.5
notes.content:
This took way longer than expected, but version 0.5 of Amazething is now available and with that you can now play on MacOS and Linux too.

See below for a (possibly) complete list of changes.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] MacOS & Linux builds are now available
[*] Level 21-28
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed player not moving when holding keys on level start
[*] Fixed some traps not working on MacOS
[*] Fixes timing of the lasers in level 19
[*] Fixed level 10 not leading to level 11
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance tweaks
[*] Some eye candy like animation of collection gems
[*] Upgraded unity engine
[*] SFX on level finish has been changed
[/list]

For the next update I will focus on finishing the last two levels, revisiting the levels to tweak their difficulty and fix some more bugs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40366616/77225561b2d5799958beef01a793f64451b5ce32.png[/img]

Fixed level 10 not leading to level 11

notes.title: Amazething v0.3.3
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] A timer was added that shows the time for your current run
[*] A counter for total and collected gems was added
[*] The UI can be toggled by pressing 'T'. Alternatively press down on a DPad.
[*] The level selection menu has been redesigned for a better gamepad experience
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] The deceleration of the player is now quicker. This allows for a more precise control.
[*] A changelog was added to the menu
[/list]

[b]Attention[/b]
Due to a change on the save system a reset of the game data might be required. You can do so in the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40366616/0dbab3cd18028c9c74f30615f16a2facfeb02aee.png[/img]

notes.title: Amazething v0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ability to manually respawn by pressing [b]R[/b] on keyboard or [b]select[/b] on a gamepad.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed escape button quitting the game instantly
[*] Removed old pause button from game UI
[*] Fixed scrolling bug in the level selection screen
[*] Fixed level selection sometimes not opening correctly
[*] Fixed a song not being played
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation breaking when clicking in empty space
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Physics are now multithreaded
[*] Default death ghost count reduced to 3
[*] Default volume reduced to 50
[*] Level selection with controller not requires a click less
[/list]
